title: Invented wearable grids
disposition: Remove derived grids; retain ItemVolume, ItemDimensions and the native inventory size enum separately.

title: Incomplete storage
disposition: Use the same source-backed storage instances for wearables, containers and vehicles, including pockets, slots, MaxCumulativeVolume and MaxItemSize.

title: Ancestor overrides
disposition: Read effective values once and preserve ancestors as separate evidence; catalog indexes reference that same record.

title: Ammunition path classification
disposition: Remove path substring classification; preserve native projectile configurations and magazine mappings.

title: Guessed caliber and designation
disposition: Remove guessed caliber spellings and Standard fallbacks; retain authored values, native magazine wells and configuration relationships.

title: Incorrect fire modes
disposition: Export configured BaseFireMode instances, UIName, burst/salvo settings and RoundsPerMinute; use no uninitialized script instance getters.

title: Duplicated installations
disposition: Keep effective and ancestor graphs separate; preserve ordered native instances and shared configuration links.

title: Invented drivetrain figures
disposition: Keep native engine, rotor, transmission and suspension fields; remove RPM multipliers, wheel-count drivetrain guesses and derived power.

title: Incomplete mounted weapons
disposition: Traverse nested components and child entities using the common weapon reader; retain actual turret settings.

title: Radio quantities mislabeled
disposition: Keep individual transceivers and their native range/frequency configuration; remove invented watts, channel counts and encryption booleans.

title: Fuel and water properties
disposition: Preserve actual fuel, buoyancy and water-propulsion properties and spellings; export no synthesized amphibious status.

title: Synthetic defaults
disposition: Remove guessed stack limits, capacities, roles, empty cargo lists and utility classifications. Native zero/false/empty values remain present.

title: Mixed measurements
disposition: Separate inventory attributes from physics bodies and projectile configuration; remove calculated loaded weights and supposed physical bounding boxes.

title: Tracer statistics
disposition: Preserve ordered AmmoMapping, MaxAmmo, configuration references and authored tracer settings; do not expand ratios or inferred functions.

title: Attachment type lists
disposition: Read slot/default-installation rules and native object constraints; expand declared ancestor candidates and verify relationships with TypeName.IsInherited.

title: Names and identity
disposition: Use native resource GUIDs or exact-name fallback; preserve original names and resolve English with WidgetManager.Translate.

title: Guessed selectable or abstract status
disposition: Remove filename-derived claims; retain native flags and technical templates as source records.

title: Stale optics and aliases
disposition: Close gameplay references within one generation and retire independent legacy views on successful publication.

title: Inconsistent contract and provenance
disposition: Use schema version 2, common source facts, coordinated indexes, environment metadata, immutable publication and hashed manifests.

title: Damage and protection
disposition: Keep hit zones, material/configuration references, geometry references and native damage settings; remove fabricated protection and thickness ratings.

title: Medical and utility semantics
disposition: Keep concrete effect classes, amounts, regeneration speeds, durations and utility configuration without altering authored values.

title: Unread defaults and guessed units
disposition: Enumerate typed source properties and fail on unsupported/failed reads; preserve native FOV, ballistic and effect data without unit guesses.

title: Mortar relationships and mass
disposition: Expose AmmoTemplate as default_projectile; retain separate compatibility constraints and native mass fields without debris/family substitutes.

title: Vehicle stations and systems
disposition: Preserve child crew stations, role/access/door relationships and electrical, instrumentation, communications, audio and damage configuration.
